messages:
Morgan: Quick huddle — we need to land a small set of copy + SDK snippet updates before the next release window. Main items: naming consistency (response vs result), a short migration note for v0.8 SDK, and a couple of broken links in /guides.
Jules: +1. I can take the naming decisions. Leaning toward `response` everywhere except where we mean a raw model `output`.
Alex: Agree with Jules. Also the SDK example in the snippets folder uses the old `create_completion` call; needs update to `generate`. Tiny PR.
Maya: I can triage the link fixes — found two bad links in the sidebar and one doc that points to the old analytics page.
Morgan: Great. Jules, can you paste the short rule set we want in docs style? We should keep it minimal.
Jules: Sure — draft: 1) Use "response" for user-facing content; 2) Use "output" for model-internal raw tokens/diagnostics; 3) Use "result" only for aggregated/reranked items.
Alex: Will update the SDK snippet. Proposed code diff:
```
# old
client.create_completion(model="rtr-1", prompt=prompt)
# new
client.generate(model="rtr-1", prompt=prompt)
```
Maya: Found the broken links: /guides/analytics -> should be /console/analytics. Sidebar entry `docs/overview/usage.md` links to internal analytics anchor that moved. I'll open a PR.
Morgan: Cool. Assignments: Jules -> wording PR + small glossary note; Alex -> update snippet + add migration blurb; Maya -> link fixes. I'll add a checklist in the PR templates so we don't miss these in future.
DevEx-Bot: Reminder: repo redwood-docs has a pending deploy scheduled in 4h. Merge conflicts could block.
Jules: Quick Q — do we want to add a one-liner in the style guide about API naming (verbs vs nouns)? I think yes: prefer verbs for action APIs (generate, rerank) and nouns for resources (model, route).
Alex: Adding migration blurb: "If you previously used create_completion, switch to generate. Field mappings: prompt->prompt, max_tokens->max_tokens (no change)." Will include a tiny code example.
Maya: PRs opened: #412 link fixes, #413 sidebar updates. Waiting on Jules for wording PR to reference.
Morgan: Targeting merge by EOD today. If anyone needs a quick review ping me in thread.
Jules: Drafted wording PR at #414. Kept it concise and added a one-line glossary entry for `response`/`output`/`result`.
Alex: #415 contains the SDK snippet and migration blurb. Tests pass locally.
Maya: All green on link fixes. Deployed preview looks correct.
Morgan: Thanks team — I'll do a final pass and merge after CI. Follow-up: add a short entry to the docs contributor checklist so this pattern is repeatable. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks — will update the SDK snippets index too.
DevEx-Bot: Merge: #413 merged by Maya at 1852003875 :rocket:
Morgan: Done — closing thread once #414 and #415 are merged.
Jules: Nice, thanks everyone.
